bio: Previously a Georgian farmhouse, Park Farm Hotel is a blissful retreat set in 200 acres of idyllic Norfolk countryside.  Enjoy the tradition of a luxurious English Afternoon Tea served in the Drawing Room. The menu includes a delicate array of sweet and savoury delights, alongside loose-leaf Newby Tea, or freshly ground coffee. For an extra special afternoon, add a glass of bubbles (or two).  Park Farm Hotel is situated on the outskirts of the city of Norwich. The hotel features an original Georgian country house, a Norfolk barn, beautifully landscaped gardens and spa facilities.
